# Funeral Cost & Burial Expense Analyzer

> An independent, educational website at funeralcostanalyzer.com that explains U.S. funeral, cremation, and burial costs. It has a free cost calculator, cost guides for all 50 states and major metro areas, line-item cost breakdowns, and plain-language guides to consumer rights under the FTC Funeral Rule. It is not a funeral home, cemetery, insurer, or insurance agent, and it does not sell funeral goods or services.

Cost figures are estimates drawn from published sources (for example, National Funeral Directors Association survey data), and actual prices vary by provider and location. The site is supported by display advertising and some affiliate links; see the Affiliate Disclosure. Content is general information, not financial, legal, or funeral-director advice.

## Core tools and data
- [Funeral Cost Calculator (home)](https://funeralcostanalyzer.com/): estimate funeral, cremation, and burial costs by state
- [Cremation vs. Burial Calculator](https://funeralcostanalyzer.com/cremation-vs-burial-calculator.html)
- [National Funeral Cost Index](https://funeralcostanalyzer.com/national-funeral-cost-index.html)
- [Funeral Costs by State](https://funeralcostanalyzer.com/funeral-costs-by-state.html)

- [Burial Costs by State](https://funeralcostanalyzer.com/burial-costs-by-state.html)
